title: feat(nm2slm): incoming exist-opposite at t+1 on two-axis same-lock y-probes: reverse fails, face fails
science: Two-axis same-lock seed, y-probes, exist-opposite of M: fail/fail, since M(A)=M(B)={+e_1}. The clean sign-sensitivity control against #7370 - exist-opposite of M is the one readout in the band that does distinguish the opposite seed from the same-lock seed on the y-probes.
